messages_body:
Hi Samir / Emily,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about ClearPath's roadmap. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the key POC/initial production numbers so we can provide a clearer hosted pricing estimate and validate whether a Dedicated instance makes sense down the line. Please see my notes and a couple of clarifying questions below.

Summary (what you shared on the call):
- Use case: customer support summarization + routing and a small set of internal analytics.
- Expected monthly token volume (initial POC -> Q1): ~120M tokens/month.
- Long-term target (12 months): 400M tokens/month if POC meets success metrics.
- Typical request profile: avg request ~550 tokens in (prompt + context) and ~150 tokens out (response).
- Concurrency & latency expectations: target p95 latency < 500ms for single-turn summarization; peak concurrency during business hours.
- Current budget: $6k–$12k/month allocated for hosted API usage in POC phase; flexibility if unit economics align.

Clarifying questions:
1) Can you confirm the expected peak TPS (requests/sec) during your busiest hour? You mentioned bursts tied to support shift changes.
2) What's the expected max response length we should plan for (tokens out)? We used 150 above but can adjust.
3) Any special compliance needs (data residency, retention) for POC?

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll put together a hosted pricing estimate with unit economics (target $/1M tokens) and projected monthly bill for the 120M token POC, including suggestions to reduce unit cost (batching, caching, response truncation).
- If numbers look good, we can enable a time-limited test key and provide a traffic runbook template for the POC.

Attaching: sample POC traffic CSV format for you to populate (POC-traffic-sample.csv).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

On Mon, Aug 30, 2026 at 2:05 PM Samir wrote:
> Hey Marissa — thanks for the recap. Very aligned.
>
> Quick answers to your questions:
> 1) Peak TPS: we expect bursts up to ~40 requests/sec during the 30–60 minute post-batch window, average steady-state ~4–6 req/sec.
> 2) Max response length: 250 tokens on some analytics responses, but 150 is more common.
> 3) Compliance: no special residency for POC; production will need EU residency for some customers.
>
> We’ll fill out the POC traffic CSV and send it back by tomorrow.
>
> - Samir
> Director of Product | ClearPath Analytics
> samir@clearpath.ai

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the detailed notes — confirming the numbers we discussed. A couple of additions from our side:
- For POC success, we’ll track cost per resolution and aim for a target that keeps total cost of ownership under $0.15 per end-user interaction.
- Average tokens per interaction (end-to-end): ~700 tokens (including system prompts & history).

Regarding the peak TPS, the 40 req/sec burst estimate is accurate; those bursts last about 20–40 minutes and align with our nightly ingestion + reprocessing window.

Appreciate the sample CSV — attaching the filled version now. Let me know if you need any traffic shape details (we can provide minute-level sample).

Best,
Samir

--- Forwarded attachment: POC-traffic-sample.csv (attachment stub)

Samir — thanks for the quick answers and the filled CSV. Based on the 120M token/month POC and the profile you provided (avg 700 tokens/interaction), here's a preliminary hosted pricing estimate and unit economics for the POC phase:

Assumptions used:
- Model class: mid-sized LLM (Redwood-curated perf profile)
- Avg tokens per interaction: 700 tokens in total (prompt + response)
- Monthly volume: 120,000,000 tokens
- Peak bursts: 40 req/sec (we'll recommend a traffic shaping strategy for those windows)

Preliminary unit economics:
- Target list price target: $5.00 per 1M tokens (example target to fit your current budget).
- Estimated monthly cost at $5/1M: 120 * $5 = $600.

Realistically, for the model class and performance you want, Redwood hosted list price would typically be in the ~$8–$15 per 1M token range depending on SLA, streaming, and model variant. Using a conservative hosted price of $9/1M gives: 120 * $9 = $1,080/month.

Given your stated budget of $6k–$12k/month, you have ample room in POC to test higher-throughput variants or an initial Dedicated eval if you want lower unit cost at scale. Example scenarios:
- $5/1M: $600/mo (aggressive promotional/volume discount)
- $9/1M: $1,080/mo (likely for mid-sized model with streaming)
- $15/1M: $1,800/mo (large model / premium SLA)

Peak TPS guidance:
- With bursts to 40 req/sec and avg 700 tokens/req, token TPS during burst ~28,000 tokens/sec.
- Our hosted runtime can handle that with autoscaling, but we recommend a short warm-up test and a burst policy (limit concurrency per API key) for the POC. If you see sustained bursts >2–3 minutes, consider reserved capacity (Dedicated).

Next steps / asks:
1) Please confirm whether the $5/1M target is a firm requirement or a target to try to hit; we can run a promotional pricing for the POC if it helps.
2) Can you share minute-level traffic for a typical burst window? That will help us size rate limits and recommend batching settings.
3) If interested, we can put you on a 30-day trial key with $5k credits to run the POC load and validate latency profiles.

I’m looping Ben on this note to confirm commercial flexibility and to see if we should propose a short-term promotional rate for the POC. Ben / Alex — can you review the unit econ and confirm if a $5/1M promo for a one-month POC is doable?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-estimate.pdf (attachment stub)

Internal — Ben / Alex,

Please confirm whether we can offer ClearPath a promotional rate of $5.00 per 1M tokens for a one-month POC (up to 200M tokens). Their stated budget gives us flexibility, but Samir highlighted $5/1M as the target that lets them greenlight the POC immediately. Key details:
- POC expected 120M tokens/month; bursts to 40 req/sec (~28k tokens/sec during burst).
- No special compliance for POC; production will need EU residency for some customers.
- Opportunity to upsell to Dedicated at ~400M tokens/month.

If promo approved, I’ll send a one-page addendum and enable a $5k trial credit.

Thanks,
Marissa
